name: Block
description: A pushable stone block that can be moved to solve puzzles or clear paths.

fields.name: Block Type
fields.description: Determines the block size or internal movement state.

0.name: 1x1 Block Movement State (Internal)
0.description: Internal movement state of a block. Uses Movement Axis to determine the movement direction and Block Variant to determine the block type.

fields.name: Movement Axis
fields.description: Restricts the 2x2 block's movement to one axis.

0.name: Horizontal
0.description: The block can move east and west.

1.name: Vertical
1.description: The block can move north and south.

2.name: Immovable
2.description: The block is fixed in place.

fields.name: Block Variant (Internal)
fields.description: Determines the block type used by the internal movement state. Value 0 is normal, value 1 is green.

fields.name: Flags
fields.description: Controls block movement behavior and direction-related room variables.

1.name: Return to Origin
1.description: The block slowly returns to its original position after it is no longer pushed.

2.name: Endlessly Movable
2.description: Uses four room variables for east, west, south, and north while the block is moving.

8.name: Movement Axis
8.description: For 2x2 blocks, restricts movement to either the east/west or north/south axis. For 3x3 and 4x4 blocks, makes the block immovable.

16.name: Full Tile Movement
16.description: Makes the block move a full tile on its first push, keeping its movement aligned to the tile grid.

fields.name: East Variable
fields.description: Room variable used for eastward movement when Endlessly Movable is enabled.

fields.name: West Variable
fields.description: Room variable used for westward movement when Endlessly Movable is enabled.

fields.name: South Variable
fields.description: Room variable used for southward movement when Endlessly Movable is enabled.

fields.name: Activation Variable / North Variable
fields.description: Room variable activated when the block has been moved, or used for northward movement when Endlessly Movable is enabled.
